{{- /*
  Every docs page in Markdown, in site order: each section page, then its
  pages by weight, then its subsections. Each page starts with its title
  and its URL. Relative links become absolute, as page.markdown.md does for
  a single copy: ../nfe/ resolves against the page's parent, nfse/ against
  the page itself. A page opts out with `llms: false`, as in llms.txt.
*/ -}}
# {{ .Site.Title }}

> {{ .Site.Params.description | default "" }}

Todas as páginas da documentação em Markdown, na ordem do site. O índice com uma linha por página está em {{ "llms.txt" | absURL }}.
{{ range where site.Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{- template "llms-full-section" . }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "llms-full-section" }}
{{- template "llms-full-page" . }}
{{- range where .RegularPages "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{- template "llms-full-page" . }}
{{- end }}
{{- range where .Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{- template "llms-full-section" . }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "llms-full-page" }}
{{- $parent := path.Dir (strings.TrimSuffix "/" .RelPermalink) | absURL | strings.TrimSuffix "/" }}
{{- $body := replace .RawContent "](../" (printf "](%s/" $parent) }}
{{- $body = replaceRE `\]\(([a-z0-9-]+/[^)]*)\)` (printf "](%s$1)" .Permalink) $body }}
---

{{ .Title | replaceRE "\n" " " | printf "# %s" }}

URL: {{ .Permalink }}

{{ $body | strings.TrimSpace }}
{{ end -}}
